title: TextLink
description: A styled native anchor for inline links, quiet navigation and settings rows; asChild styles a router link without nesting anchors.

support.notes: Native route navigator with default/subtle/action variants, chevron, disabled guard and native tap event. External browser anchors and asChild router refs require native platform routing. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

translationResources.title: TextLink

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: default is underlined, subtle adds a chevron as a non-color cue, action is a full-width row.

as-child.title: Router links
as-child.description: asChild merges the styling onto its single child element.

TextLinkProps.asChild: Merges the link styling onto its single child element
TextLinkProps.variant: Visual style: default, subtle or action

cssVars.--text-link-action-min-height: Minimum height of the action variant

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A native <a> in a shadow root: href, target, rel, hreflang and download are forwarded to it.

variants.title: Variants and routing
variants.description: default is underlined, subtle adds a chevron, action is a settings row. Clicks are intercepted on the host, like a client-side router would.

styling.title: CSS variables
styling.description: Color, weight, underline and its offset are tuned per link with CSS variables.

props.target: Browsing context where the link opens (_blank...).
props.download: Downloads the target instead of navigating (optional file name).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner link.
